parameters.subject: We Tried Reaching You - SolarEase Solutions
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Results').first().json.first_name }},

We tried reaching you by phone today to talk about how solar could help lower your electricity bills, but we were not able to connect.

If you would still like to hear about our solar options, simply reply to this email and we will reconnect at a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
SolarEase Solutions
123 GreenTech Avenue, San Diego, CA 92101
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (PST)

parameters.subject: Thank You for Your Time - SolarEase Solutions
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Results').first().json.first_name }},

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today. We completely understand that solar is not the right fit for everyone right now.

If your needs change in the future, you are always welcome to reach out to us and we will be happy to help.

Kind regards,
SolarEase Solutions
123 GreenTech Avenue, San Diego, CA 92101
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (PST)

parameters.subject: Thanks for Your Interest - Next Steps with SolarEase
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Results').first().json.first_name }},

Thank you for speaking with us about solar for your home. Here is what happens next:

  • Our team will review the details you shared, including your roof, energy usage and financing preference.
  • We will prepare an indicative system size and price estimate. Systems typically range from $10,000 to $25,000 depending on system size and site.
  • A solar consultant will then walk you through the options and arrange a site assessment.
{{ $('Normalize Results').first().json.callback_time ? '

You mentioned ' + $('Normalize Results').first().json.callback_time + ' as a good time to connect, and we will aim for that.

' : '

To help us schedule, just reply to this email with a day and time that works for you.

' }}

Kind regards,
SolarEase Solutions
123 GreenTech Avenue, San Diego, CA 92101
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (PST)

nodeGroups.name: Prepare lead list
nodeGroups.description: Loads call settings and pulls leads from the sheet that have a phone number and have not been called yet

nodeGroups.name: Place AI sales calls
nodeGroups.description: One lead at a time: builds the caller script, dials the lead, marks the row, then pauses before the next call

nodeGroups.name: Capture call results
nodeGroups.description: When a call ends, checks the secret, sets the final outcome and writes each answer to its own sheet column

nodeGroups.name: Send outcome follow-up
nodeGroups.description: Emails the lead the template matching their outcome, then records that the email went out
